# Draft:Battle of Tambakberas River

Battle of Tambakberas River was a battle fought between the forces of Ranggalawe against the Majapahit Empire, taking place sometime in 1295, and was the culmination of Ranggalawe's Rebellion. Led by its first Prime Minister, Nambi, Majapahit's forces successfully defeated the rebels, with Ranggalawe himself slain following a single combat against Mahisa Anabrang, one of the commanders of Majapahit's forces. The battle is believed to have taken place at present day Tambakberas village in Gresik, East Java.
